notes.title: Update 0.3.1 | Patch notes

This patch is a small update to add in missing NPC voice lines and update the world map.



Changes & Bug Fixes:

New armour items added

World map updated to include hunters rise, the lonely lodge and bandits hollow

notes.title: Update 0.3.0 - Bandits Hollow - Part 1 | Patch notes
notes.notes:
The horns of war have sounded, it's time to return to Fort Coldwraith and join the attack on Bandits Hollow in this latest update to Tundralia: The Frigid Frontier. Undertake several new quests and increase your experience up to level 12, unlocking a new class ability in the process. You can also earn a variety of new items and armour, take on some new enemies in Bandits Hollow, and there is more to come!

As with 0.2.0, this is just the first part of the update and in the near future we will add more quests, additional equipment, and a new dungeon to conclude the 0.3 story, so stay tuned for that! 



Bandit's Hollow:

The gates to bandit's hollow are now open allowing you to explore the bandits hideout

2 new main quests have been added which can be started following the 'Preparing for war' main story quest

1 new side quests have been added



Changes & Bug Fixes:

2 new levels added, meaning you can now earn xp up to level 12

New level 12 marauder skill 'Head slam' added

New level 12 witch skill 'Exchange pain' added

New level 12 ranger skill 'Explosive arrow' added

The ranger ability 'Call of the wild' particle effects now display correctly

The ranger ability 'Summon crow' has been updated with a new attack animation

The witch ability 'Surrender to fear' now displays damage numbers

6 new furniture items added, earnt from quests or brought from different merchants 

You can now double click items in your inventory to use them

The minimap, collectables, currencies, and reputation buttons should no longer become focusable when playing with a controller

Increased the attack delay and respawn delay on bandit camp guards

When aggressive enemies respawn they now have a 5s delay where they will not retarget the player character if in close proximity

Optimisations made to the landscape, lighting and NPCs

notes.title: Development Update | Bandit's Hollow
notes.notes:
Hi all, it's crazy to think that Tundralia has been out for nearly 6 months now and what a time it's been. We've seen a lot bugs fixed and quality of life improvements made, as well as the addition of Hunters Rise and The Hollow Vault, but what's next I hear you cry?

Well without spoiling too much, patch 0.3.0 will extend the main storyline and add an additional 2 levels, bringing the max level to 12. This is alongside new level 12 class abilities, new side quests to complete and a new dungeon to explore.

As you can imagine, we're working hard on getting this patch ready and all going well, we are aiming to have this live by mid July. But in the meantime, here's a sneak peak at where we are heading next in the main story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41645171/a0f0be37b3b850a156a354287e7cfb497ad42991.png
Thanks again to everyone who has been playing the game and leaving feedback on the Steam discussion board. Tundralia is my passion project that I code outside of my 9 till 5 job so it's been amazing to see you all playing and enjoying the game, as well as hearing your suggestions for how to make it even better, so keep it coming!

notes.title: Update 0.2.9 | Patch notes
notes.notes:
This patch is a small update to make some minor bug fixes and build out the gamepad controls further.

Changes & Bug Fixes:

Further gamepad controls added
Several lighting bugs fixed

notes.title: Update 0.2.8 - Hunter's Rise - Part 2 | Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi all, this patch concludes the second part of the Hunter's Rise update by adding the 2 boss dungeon, The Hollow Vault, which can be found via the cave entrance under the ruined watch. The dungeon will continue the story started in the quest 'Wayward Rookie' so make sure to visit Jes'ika again to pick up the next quest in the chain 'Breaking into the vault'.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41645171/b0a1b5464039d1f175a0c5229a8c01cd8015ffb3.png

Speaking of quests, this is 1 of 3 added with the update. Not only that, we've also refactored some existing dungeon armour drops into 3 new armour sets. Currently you can earn 4 pieces of the 7-piece armour sets from the dungeon bosses in the game. The remaining items from the set will be added to the game with the next dungeon in the 0.3.0 Bandit's Hollow update.

That is just some of the changes the update brings, there is also a new rift event, items to collect and quality of life improvements. So we hope you enjoy today's update and thanks again for supporting Tundralia!

Changes & Bug Fixes:

The Hollow Vault dungeon added including a new Steam achievement for killing the last boss
3 new quests added - '[Lvl. 6] Checking on the hunters', '[Lvl. 7] Researching the past', and '[Lvl. 10] Breaking into the vault'
New rift event added - 'Free Treasure?'
Spawn VFX added to all rift bosses
Rift bosses now drop new demonic weapons
New armour and furniture items added which can be looted from the 2 bosses in the hollow vault dungeon
Bone Shoulderplate updated to no longer clip with the players chest
Malignant Spaulder will now appear correctly
Marauders Guards now named correctly
Bone Shoulderplate and Golem Bone Helm updated to be apart of the 7-piece marauder 'Bone Guard Armour' set which drops from dungeons
Malignant Spaulder and Forsaken Cowl updated to be apart of the 7-piece ranger 'Stalkers Set' which drops from dungeons
Ice Shard Crown and Necromancer's Mantle updated to be apart of the 7-piece witch 'Necromancers Attire' set which drops from dungeons
Sound volume buttons changed to a slider in the settings menu
Large Mouse cursor toggle button added to the settings menu
Nia Wue has now learnt to breath when speaking so should no longer speak as fast
NPC textures reduced and optimised
Stairs added to the back of blue spore lake ruins to allow for easier access

notes.title: Update 0.2.7 | Patch notes
notes.notes:
Hi all, today's update includes some bug fixes to the quest system, including the addition of the cancel quest button to the quest book.


Rangers can how train the Summon Crow ability at level 10
A quest will now be selected correctly when loading a save game
Fixed issue with quests not completing when playing from a save game
The final 'Reporting on the raiders' quest goal now displays in yellow on the mini map
Quests can now be cancelled by clicking the cancel button in the quest book
Holding the right click button and dying will no longer hide the mouse cursor
Optimisations made to the landscape


Please note, as a result of changes to quests in the 0.2.4 patch, you may encounter an issue where you cannot progress a quest any further, despite meeting the requirements, when playing from a save made before the 6th of March. If you do encounter this issue, please try cancelling the broken quests, and redoing them again. This bug only affects existing saves and any new saves should not encounter this issue.

notes.title: Development Update | Hunter's Rise Part 2
notes.notes:
Hi all, to keep you in the loop with development we wanted to tease what we have been working on outside of the usual bug fix and quality of life improvement patches that have been going live over the last couple of months.

Patch 0.2.0, Hunter's Rise, launched in January adding a new small island to explore designed for levels 4 to 9, aiming to add additional content to do outside of the main questline and side quests in Fort Coldwraith. This was just the first half of the patch, and we are planning to have the second half ready by early April.

The second half of Hunter's Rise update will add some additional quests to complete, new rift content and a new level 10 dungeon, The Hollow Vault. This will be a 2 boss dungeon and will continue the story started in the quest 'Wayward Rookie'. We won't spill too many details as we want you to explore the dungeon and it's story for yourself, but here is a sneak peak at it's interior.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41645171/42b5c46ec29d446673bdd2b2ebee2cb6b18883bf.png

We're excited to conclude the 0.2.0 update and begin working on the next big patch, Bandit's Hollow, which will continue the main storyline and add a additional 2 levels, bringing the max level to 12. But we'll talk more about that in the coming months.

Thanks again to everyone who has been playing the game and leaving feedback on the Steam discussion board, it's been so valuable hearing your suggestions and being able to implement them in the game, so keep it coming!

notes.title: Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that in just under 2 months time, on December 7th, Tundralia shall be releasing into early access!

It has been a long 3 years of development to get the game into a state in which we are happy to share it with you, and there are still plenty of things we'd like to build upon and add to the game which is why we are releasing as early access. It is our aim to be able to get the game into your hands as soon as possible, rather than waiting another year or so for us to flesh things out further. This way we can take players input onboard for what bugs need fixing, what aspects of the game need developing out, and which features you'd like to see added to the game. But, it is important to note, that as this will be an early access release it does mean that there will be bugs and features that need developing further.

In the initial version of the game you will be able to level up your character to level 10 as either a marauder, witch or ranger, complete around 30 quests, explore 1 dungeon, take part in a basic version of the open world rift system (both of which will be the focus of our next feature spotlight), craft and equip armour, earn reputation with 2 factions, and find 2 collections which reward cosmetic pets. Then over the months following launch, we will continuously build upon the game, updating it with bug fixes and additional content as we work towards a full launch of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41645171/a61a1ffc24486bb7cf6bc279dd2b3d0817dfffcb.jpg

Our vision for the full 1.0 launch of the game is that you can level up to 30, complete more quests over new landscapes, and delve into several more dungeons over the leveling experience and at max level, all while we further develop the rifts, crafting, and collection systems. This doesn't mean that development will finish once we reach the 1.0 launch either, we have plenty of ideas for future updates once the foundation experience has been solidified too.

We're excited to launch in early access on the 7th of December and we can't wait for you to experience the game and go on this adventure together as we build Tundralia into something magical.
